title: Built Kart Científico with Opus 5.5 Ultra — a playable science-themed kart game
author: Typical-Instance-376
selftext:
Hi r/aigamedev — I’m Samuel, a physics teacher and the creator of Quanta Aulas. I made Kart Científico with help from Opus 5.5 Ultra. The browser game brings Newton, Curie, Einstein and other scientists to a race around the Campus of Science, with a daily challenge and online play by code.



This is a playable browser build, not just a trailer: [https://quantaaulas.com/kart-cientifico/](https://quantaaulas.com/kart-cientifico/)



For the AI-development discussion, I’m interested in where the game needs the most human iteration next. Does the science theme feel integrated with the racing? What would you improve first: onboarding, race feedback, or the learning prompts? I’ll answer questions about the project and appreciate candid feedback.
